author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Midjourney Medical has developed a device that uses AI-enhanced ultrasound to produce MRI-quality full-body scans in just 60 seconds. This technology operates approximately 100 times faster and at a tenth of the cost of traditional MRI machines, promising to revolutionize diagnostics worldwide.
